episodes.title: Relda
episodes.summary: Sabrina and Daphne arrive in Ferryport to start a new chapter with their eccentric grandmother.

episodes.title: Puck
episodes.summary: The sisters team up with Puck, the town's resident trickster, to rescue Relda and Mr. Canis from a giant's pocket.

episodes.title: Jack
episodes.summary: Sabrina and Daphne stage a jailbreak with the help of a magic carpet.

episodes.title: Prince Charming
episodes.summary: At Mayor Charming's ball, the girls secretly gather intel on the Grimm family legacy.

episodes.title: The Giant, Part 1
episodes.summary: After learning the truth about the giants, the sisters gear up to stop them once and for all.

episodes.title: The Giant, Part 2
episodes.summary: The Grimms band together and put up a fight to keep Ferryport Landing safe.
